20261121-physics-e6-2.s.s1.explain: Atu halo eletroíman forte liu, tenke aumenta bobina nia dala kesi, ka aumenta bateria iha série atu aumenta korente sulin iha sirkuitu.

20261122-physics-e6-1.material: [Aplikasaun avansada] Bainhira haree letra jornál ho lupa (lente konvexa) besik tebes, letra sai boot no hamriik loos, maibé se hasai ba dook, letra sai inverte. Tansá bainhira besik, letra hare hamriik loos?
20261122-physics-e6-1.thinking.0: Bainhira haree letra jornál ho lupa
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.prompt: [Aplikasaun avansada] Bainhira haree letra jornál ho lupa (lente konvexa) besik tebes, letra sai boot no hamriik loos, maibé se hasai ba dook, letra sai inverte. Tansá bainhira besik, letra hare hamriik loos?
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.explain: Bainhira objetu iha laran husi distánsia fokál lente konvexa, liña estensaun husi naroman refratadu hasoru malu no forma imajen virtual boot liu duké objetu no hamriik loos (imajen virtual hamriik boot).
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.hint.0: Hanoin kona-ba naroman nia dalan bainhira objetu besik liu distánsia fokál.
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.hint.1: Tanba naroman fahe, tenke hakerek liña estensaun iha lente nia kotuk atu hasoru.
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o0: Tanba letra iha laran husi distánsia fokál lente nian no hare imajen virtual boot ne'ebé hamriik loos
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.o.o1: Tanba naroman reflete hanesan espellu iha lente nia superfísie

20261122-physics-e6-2.topic: Tansá mak la bele toka plugue
20261122-physics-e6-2.goal: Apply principles of Tansá mak la bele toka plugue to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e6-2.material: Tansá mak la bele toka plugue eletrisidade ka interruptor eletrodoméstiku ho liman bee?
20261122-physics-e6-2.thinking.0: Tansá mak la bele toka plugue
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.prompt: Tansá mak la bele toka plugue eletrisidade ka interruptor eletrodoméstiku ho liman bee?
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.explain: Bainhira kulit bee, rezistensia eletrika isin nian tun makas ba parte barak husi nia normál, no maske ho tensaun ki'ik, korente mortál sulin liuhusi isin no kauza asidente choke eletriku.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.0: La hanesan bee puru, bee ho loron-loron iha eletrólitu ne'ebé nakfakar.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.1: Liman bee halo rezistensia ba kulit tun makas no korente sulin fasil.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o0: Tanba iha bee laran iha íon inorgánika neʼebé halo eletrisidade liu fasil no risku choke eletriku aumenta lalais
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o1: Tanba bee-nurak halo plugue malirin no sai gelu
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o2: Tanba liman bee halo forsa magnétika
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o3: Tanba eletrisidade halo bee iha liman evapora hotu
